title: The Bone Furnace
text: Devils feed bones into a great furnace by the barrowful, and it breathes the heat of the Pit in long red gusts. Ash falls like snow around it. Its stokers lean on their shovels between loads, yawning, bored out of their minds.

options.label: Sneak past while the stokers work.

outcomes.text: Past, sweating, eyes stinging with ash.
A stoker looks up, and grins, and stops being bored.

options.label: The shrewdest bribes the stokers with gossip.

outcomes.text: They love it, gasping at every rival's shame, and wave you through.
It goes out with a roar, and so do the devils who fed it.
